## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new flag should honor its required environment default so CI exclusions take effect.

## Changes
The pull request adds repeatable filename glob exclusions, documents the flag, and adds parser, collection, and archive tests. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclusion default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude`, matching files are archived because the default is always `[]`. This violates .agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11: “Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment cannot apply their intended archive filters.
